subject: Mobile Development
title: Beta Testing and TestFlight
description: Learn Beta Testing and TestFlight in one minute.

hook.text: Before an app hits the store, it needs real users to find bugs the developer missed.

buildup.text: Apple's TestFlight and Google Play's beta tracks let developers distribute pre-release builds.

discovery.text: Beta testers get early access and provide feedback before the public release.

twist.text: Some critical bugs only appear on specific devices or with specific data — beta catches those.

climax.text: Beta testing is the last safety net between a developer's optimism and reality.

punchline.text: Ship to a few before you ship to millions.

quiz.question: What is Apple's beta testing platform called?
